title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly express the ratio of pressure to viscosity as the average number of collisions per unit time.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must calculate the number of collisions per unit time at STP accurately.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly use the values of pressure, viscosity, and other constants in their calculations.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria - The student should show the derivation of the relationship between pressure, viscosity, and collision frequency.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria - The student could discuss limiting cases or assumptions made in the derivation.
